title: More than 200 ticked parts disables Activate on the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create 201 parts for this test whose part numbers start with the same text, so one search lists all 201, and set all 201 inactive.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Scroll the list down until no more rows load.
  3. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Activate parts.
  5. Click the checkbox in the header row.
  6. Hover over Activate on the dark bar.
  7. Click any one ticked row.
  8. Hover over Activate.
  9. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The first parts are listed.

Step 2:

  • All 201 parts are listed.

Step 3:

  • The menu opens.

Step 4:

  • Bulk mode turns on with an Activate button.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 201 selected.

Step 6:

  • The Activate button is dimmed (disabled) and hovering it shows "Select 200 parts or fewer."

Step 7:

  • The bar reads 200 selected.

Step 8:

  • The Activate button is bright blue (enabled) and no hover text appears.

Step 9:

  • Bulk mode ends and all 201 parts are still on the Inactive tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • S2-R8a: “One change takes at most 200 parts. With more than 200 rows ticked, the Deactivate button is disabled, and hovering it shows "Select 200 parts or fewer."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Deactivate or Activate hovered with more than 200 ticked | "Select 200 parts or fewer." | Tooltip on the disabled button”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
